leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component with reactive state to manage accordion sections
Implement click handlers to toggle the visibility of individual accordion items
Bind dynamic CSS classes to control the open/closed visual states
Configure computed properties to track which accordion section is currently active
Render conditional content within accordion panels using Vue directives
Integrate props to make the accordion component reusable with different data sets
Manipulate the component's internal state to allow only one section open at a time (optional)
